title: GI Emergencies: Bleeding, Vomiting and the PCP's Antiemetics

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already position vomiting patients, suction, give oxygen and treat shock. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Read GI bleeding and fluid loss more deeply: blood clues and orthostatic vitals
  2. Run the BC Nausea–Vomiting protocol with ondansetron and dimenhydrinate
  3. Treat a GI bleed with the PCP side of the Hypovolemia protocol, and know the new risks

Textbook: Chapter 34, PDF pages 2977–3044
slides.say: Welcome back. Today's topic is the belly: gastrointestinal, or GI, emergencies. As EMRs, you already know the basics: turn a vomiting patient to protect the airway, keep suction ready, give oxygen, and treat shock with positioning and warmth. As a PCP, more is expected. First, you'll read GI bleeding and fluid loss more deeply, from the colour of the blood to orthostatic vital signs. Second, you now have two antiemetics, which are drugs that stop nausea and vomiting: ondansetron and dimenhydrinate. Third, a bleeding GI patient may need your IV and fluid under the BC hypovolemia protocol, and that brings new risks.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。今天讲腹部，也就是消化道（GI）急症。作为 EMR，你们已经会基本功：把呕吐的病人侧过来保护气道、备好吸引器、给氧，用体位和保暖处理休克。作为 PCP，要求更高。第一，你要更深入地判读消化道出血和液体丢失，从血的颜色到体位性生命体征。第二，你现在有两种止吐药，也就是止恶心呕吐的药：昂丹司琼和茶苯海明。第三，消化道出血的病人可能需要你按 BC 低血容量流程开静脉、补液，这也带来新的风险。

slides.title: Belly pain: three kinds
slides.body:
Visceralfrom the organ itselfdull, hard to locate
Referredfelt far awaygallbladder → right shoulder
Somaticbelly-wall lining irritatedsharp, easy to point to

Four belly pains that kill fast: MI, ruptured AAA, ruptured ectopic pregnancy, ruptured hollow organ.
slides.say: Let's start with pain, the most common GI complaint. There are three kinds. Visceral pain comes from the organ itself. It's dull and hard to locate, like early appendicitis felt around the belly button. Referred pain is felt far from the organ, because they share nerves; the gallbladder can hurt in the right shoulder, and the pancreas in the back. Somatic pain comes from the parietal peritoneum, the lining of the belly wall. It's sharp, and the patient can point to it. As a PCP, also keep four killers in mind: a heart attack, a ruptured aortic aneurysm, a ruptured ectopic pregnancy, and a ruptured hollow organ.
slides.sayZh: 先说疼痛，这是最常见的消化道主诉，分三种。内脏痛来自器官本身，钝、难定位，比如阑尾炎早期在肚脐周围痛。牵涉痛出现在远离器官的地方，因为共用神经：胆囊可以痛到右肩，胰腺痛到后背。躯体痛来自壁腹膜，也就是腹壁内衬，锐痛，病人能指出位置。作为 PCP，还要记住四个致命原因：心梗、腹主动脉瘤破裂、异位妊娠破裂和空腔脏器破裂。

slides.title: Vomiting and diarrhea: fluid and salts
slides.body:
Thirsty, normal vitals→Tachycardia→Hypotension
  • Fluid moves cells → tissue → vessels to compensate
  • Low BP = severe; the reserve is used up
  • Vomiting and diarrhea both lose potassium
  • Low potassium: weakness, flat T waves, U waves, arrhythmias
  • Sodium may go high or low → confusion, seizures
slides.say: Vomiting and diarrhea drain fluid, and the body hides the loss at first. Water moves out of the cells, into the tissue, and then into the vessels to keep the blood volume up. So the order you'll see is: thirst with normal vital signs, then a fast heart rate, and only at the end low blood pressure, when there's nothing left to move. Both vomiting and diarrhea also lose potassium. Low potassium causes weakness and, on the ECG, flat T waves, U waves and dangerous rhythms. Sodium can go too high or too low, and either can cause confusion or seizures. This patient may need your fluid bolus.
slides.sayZh: 呕吐和腹泻会丢液体，身体一开始会把丢失藏起来：水从细胞里移到组织间隙，再进入血管，维持血容量。所以你看到的顺序是：先口渴、生命体征正常，然后心率加快，最后才血压下降，那时已经没有液体可调动了。呕吐和腹泻都会丢钾。低钾会导致无力，心电图上 T 波低平、出现 U 波和危险心律。钠可能过高也可能过低，都会引起意识混乱或抽搐。这样的病人可能需要你给补液。

slides.title: Upper or lower? Read the blood
slides.body:
What you seeMeaning
Coffee-ground vomitupper GI blood, digested by stomach acid
Bright red blood in vomitfresh, often mouth or esophagus
Melena: black, tarry, foul stoolusually upper GI
Hematochezia: blood visible in stoolusually lower GI
Occult bloodfound only by a lab test

Bright red from the rectum can also be a very fast upper GI bleed.
slides.say: Blood tells you where it came from. Vomiting blood is called hematemesis. If it looks like coffee grounds, stomach acid has already digested it, so it's from the upper GI tract. Bright red blood in the vomit is fresh, often from the mouth or esophagus. In the stool, melena means black, tarry, very foul-smelling stool; blood turns black on its long trip through the gut, so think upper GI. Hematochezia means you can still see the blood in the stool, usually from the lower GI tract. One trap: a very fast upper GI bleed can rush through and come out bright red. Occult bleeding is hidden; only a lab test finds it.
slides.sayZh: 血能告诉你从哪里来。呕血叫 hematemesis。像咖啡渣的，已经被胃酸消化过，来自上消化道。呕吐物里有鲜红的血，是新鲜血，常来自口腔或食管。粪便方面，黑便（melena）是黑色柏油样、非常臭的便；血在肠道里走了很长的路才变黑，所以想上消化道。便血（hematochezia）是还能在粪便里看见血，多来自下消化道。有一个陷阱：上消化道出血非常快时，血冲下来也可以是鲜红的。隐性出血是看不见的，只有化验才能发现。

slides.q: A 66-year-old man takes aspirin every day. He feels dizzy and has passed black, sticky, very foul-smelling stool twice today. Where is the bleeding most likely coming from?
options: The upper GI tract, such as the stomach
slides.say: Time for a question. A sixty-six-year-old man takes aspirin every day. He feels dizzy and has passed black, sticky, very foul-smelling stool twice today. Where is the bleeding most likely coming from? A, the rectum or anus. B, the upper GI tract, such as the stomach. C, the lower colon. D, the kidneys. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做一道题。一位六十六岁男性每天吃阿司匹林。他感到头晕，今天排了两次黑色、黏稠、非常臭的大便。出血最可能来自哪里？A 直肠或肛门；B 上消化道，比如胃；C 下段结肠；D 肾脏。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Black, tarry, foul-smelling stool is melena, which usually means upper GI blood that has been digested on its long trip through the gut. Daily aspirin irritates the stomach lining and affects clotting, which fits the picture. Bleeding from the rectum or anus, A, is usually bright red. A lower colon source, C, usually gives visible blood in the stool, called hematochezia. The kidneys, D, cause blood in the urine, not black stool.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。黑色柏油样、恶臭的大便就是黑便，通常说明是上消化道的血，在肠道里长途运行时被消化了。每天吃阿司匹林会刺激胃黏膜、影响凝血，正好吻合。A 直肠或肛门出血通常是鲜红色；C 下段结肠出血通常是能看见血的便血；D 肾脏出血表现为血尿，不是黑便。

slides.title: Orthostatic vitals: the 20-10-20 check
slides.body:
Lying: BP + HR→Sit or stand (support them)→Wait 1–2 min, repeat
  • Systolic drops 20 mm Hg, or
  • Diastolic rises 10 (narrow pulse pressure), or
  • Heart rate rises 20 → significant volume loss
  • Positive at about 15–20% acute loss; over 30% → shock

Already hypotensive lying down? You have your answer. Don't stand them up.
slides.say: As an EMR you took vital signs. As a PCP you'll use them as a measuring tool. Orthostatic vital signs show how much volume a bleeding or dehydrated patient has lost. Take the blood pressure and heart rate lying down. Then help the patient sit or stand, wait one to two minutes, and repeat, ready to catch them if they faint. Remember twenty, ten, twenty: a systolic drop of twenty, a diastolic rise of ten, or a heart rate rise of twenty. Any one means a significant loss. It usually appears at fifteen to twenty percent acute loss, and above thirty percent, shock is almost always present. It also tells you how to move them.
slides.sayZh: 当 EMR 时你测生命体征；当 PCP，你要把它当测量工具。体位性生命体征能显示出血或脱水的病人丢了多少容量。先卧位测血压和心率，再扶病人坐起或站起，等一到两分钟复测，随时准备扶住，防止晕倒。记住二十、十、二十：收缩压下降二十、舒张压上升十，或心率增加二十，任何一项都说明丢失明显。通常急性丢失百分之十五到二十时出现，超过百分之三十几乎必有休克。它也决定你怎么搬运病人。

slides.title: Where GI bleeding comes from
slides.body:
SourceClues
Esophageal varicescirrhosis, alcohol; sudden heavy bright-red vomiting, shock
Mallory-Weiss tearafter repeated hard vomiting; often stops by itself
Boerhaave rupturefull tear; chest pain, infection; can mimic MI
Peptic ulcerNSAIDs, alcohol, H. pylori; may bleed with no warning
Hemorrhoidssmall amounts of bright red; looks dramatic
slides.say: Here are the main sources. Esophageal varices are swollen veins at the bottom of the esophagus, caused by cirrhosis, which is liver scarring, often from alcohol. When they burst, the patient vomits large amounts of bright red blood and goes into shock fast. A Mallory-Weiss tear is a tear in the lining after repeated forceful vomiting; it often stops by itself. Boerhaave syndrome is a full rupture of the esophagus; it causes chest pain and infection, and can look like a heart attack. Peptic ulcers are linked to NSAIDs, alcohol and a bacterium, H. pylori, and many bleed with no earlier symptoms. Hemorrhoids bleed small amounts that look scary in toilet water.
slides.sayZh: 几个主要来源：食管静脉曲张是食管下端扩张的静脉，由肝硬化（肝脏瘢痕化）引起，常与酒精有关；一旦破裂，病人大量呕鲜血，很快休克。马-魏综合征是反复剧烈呕吐后黏膜撕裂，常自行止血。布尔哈夫综合征是食管全层破裂，引起胸痛和感染，可能像心梗。消化性溃疡与 NSAIDs、酒精和幽门螺杆菌有关，很多人出血前没有任何症状。痔出血量少，但染红马桶水看起来很吓人。

slides.title: Other belly emergencies to recognize
slides.body:
ConditionKey clue
CholecystitisRUQ pain after a fatty meal → right shoulder; fever
Pancreatitisupper belly pain straight through to the back
Appendicitisbelly button → right lower quadrant; fever
Diverticulitisleft lower quadrant pain, fever; often over 60
Bowel obstructioncramps, no stool or gas, vomiting
slides.say: You don't diagnose these on scene, but recognizing the pattern sharpens your report and your functional enquiry, which as a PCP includes the GI and GU system. Cholecystitis, an inflamed gallbladder, gives right upper pain after a fatty meal, often spreading to the right shoulder, with fever. Pancreatitis gives upper belly pain that goes straight through to the back; alcohol and gallstones are the main causes. Appendicitis starts around the belly button and moves to the right lower quadrant. Diverticulitis is usually left lower pain with fever in someone over sixty. A bowel obstruction gives cramping, no stool or gas, and vomiting. Many of these patients vomit, which brings us to your new protocol.
slides.sayZh: 这些病不需要在现场确诊，但认出规律能让你的报告和系统问诊更到位；作为 PCP，系统问诊包括消化/泌尿系统。胆囊炎是右上腹痛，常在高脂餐后，放射到右肩，伴发热。胰腺炎是上腹痛直透后背，主因是酒精和胆结石。阑尾炎从肚脐周围开始，转移到右下腹。憩室炎多是六十岁以上的人左下腹痛伴发热。肠梗阻是绞痛、不排便不排气、呕吐。这些病人很多会呕吐，这就引出你的新流程。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: Nausea–Vomiting protocol
slides.body:
BC labels this a PCP protocol. Use it for any patient with nausea or vomiting.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Rest in a position of comfort
  • Position to protect the airway
  • Expect vomiting; suction ready

PCP adds

  • Consider IV access
  • Consider dimenhydrinate or ondansetron
  • Hypotension from volume loss: 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL; target systolic 90
  • Stable: antiemetic on scene. Unstable: en route
slides.say: Here's the BC Nausea–Vomiting protocol, and BC labels it a PCP protocol. The all-levels column is short: rest in a position of comfort, positioning that protects the airway, and suction ready. That's what you did as an EMR. The PCP column is where the treatment is. Consider an IV. Consider dimenhydrinate or ondansetron. If the patient is hypotensive from volume loss, give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred millilitres and after every bolus, aiming for a systolic of ninety. And timing matters: a stable patient can get the antiemetic on scene, but an unstable patient gets it en route.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的恶心呕吐流程，BC 把它标为 PCP 流程。所有级别那一栏很短：舒适体位休息、保持能保护气道的体位、备好吸引器，这些你当 EMR 时就在做。治疗都在 PCP 那一栏：考虑开静脉；考虑茶苯海明或昂丹司琼；如果是容量丢失导致的低血压，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升以及每次推注后都要复评，目标收缩压九十。时机也很重要：稳定的病人可以在现场给止吐药，不稳定的病人在转运途中给。

slides.title: Your two antiemetics
slides.body:
OndansetronDimenhydrinate
Doseadult 4 mg PO; 6 mo–4 yr 2 mg; 4 yr+ 4 mg1 mg/kg, max 50 mg; looks under 25 kg → contact ER
Routeby mouthIM undiluted, or IV diluted, slowly over 1–2 min
Don't giveallergy, congenital long QT; PKU (dissolving tablet)allergy
Cautionfirst trimester (relative)glaucoma, asthma/COPD, heart disease, prostate, elderly, pregnancy
slides.say: Let's compare your two antiemetics. Ondansetron is given by mouth: four milligrams for an adult, two milligrams for a child from six months to four years, and four milligrams from age four. Don't give it with an allergy or congenital long QT syndrome, an inherited heart rhythm problem. The dissolving tablet may contain aspartame, so avoid it in PKU, and early pregnancy is a relative contraindication. Dimenhydrinate, or Gravol, is one milligram per kilogram, maximum fifty; contact the ER if the patient looks under twenty-five kilograms. Give it IM undiluted, or IV diluted with saline, slowly over one to two minutes. Take care in the elderly, glaucoma, asthma or COPD, heart disease, prostate problems and pregnancy.
slides.sayZh: 比较一下你的两种止吐药。昂丹司琼口服：成人四毫克，六个月到四岁的孩子两毫克，四岁及以上四毫克。过敏或先天性长 QT 综合征（一种遗传性心律问题）不能给。口崩片可能含阿斯巴甜，苯丙酮尿症（PKU）要避免；妊娠早期是相对禁忌。茶苯海明（Gravol）按每公斤一毫克，最多五十毫克；病人看起来不到二十五公斤要联系急诊。肌注不稀释；静脉要用生理盐水稀释，一到两分钟慢推。老人、青光眼、哮喘或 COPD、心脏病、前列腺问题和孕妇要谨慎。

slides.q: You're a PCP. A stable 34-year-old woman has vomited all night with a stomach bug. She is Indigenous, and her brother has been diagnosed with long QT syndrome. Which plan fits BC guidance?
options: Dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg (max 50 mg), on scene since she is stable
No antiemetic is allowed with a family history of long QT
Ondansetron 8 mg PO, given en route
slides.say: Now a PCP decision. You're a PCP. A stable thirty-four-year-old woman has vomited all night with a stomach bug. She is Indigenous, and her brother has been diagnosed with long QT syndrome. Which plan fits BC guidance? A, ondansetron four milligrams by mouth on scene. B, dimenhydrinate one milligram per kilogram, maximum fifty, on scene since she is stable. C, no antiemetic is allowed with a family history of long QT. D, ondansetron eight milligrams by mouth, given en route. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。你是 PCP。一位情况稳定的三十四岁女性因胃肠炎吐了一整夜。她是原住民，她哥哥被诊断有长 QT 综合征。哪个方案符合 BC 指引？A 现场口服昂丹司琼四毫克；B 茶苯海明每公斤一毫克、最多五十毫克，她稳定所以在现场给；C 有长 QT 家族史就不能用任何止吐药；D 途中口服昂丹司琼八毫克。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. BC's ondansetron monograph says to ask Indigenous patients whether they or their family have been diagnosed with long QT syndrome, and if so, dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic. She's stable, so it can be given on scene. A ignores the family history. C is wrong because dimenhydrinate is the recommended alternative. D is wrong twice: it's still ondansetron, and the BC adult dose is four milligrams, not eight.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 的昂丹司琼药物说明要求询问原住民病人本人或家人有没有被诊断长 QT 综合征，如果有，推荐用茶苯海明。她情况稳定，可以在现场给。A 忽略了家族史；C 错在茶苯海明就是推荐的替代药；D 错两处：仍然是昂丹司琼，而且 BC 成人剂量是四毫克，不是八毫克。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the bleeding GI patient
slides.body:
BC Hypovolemia protocol: hypovolemia + systolic < 90 + other signs of shock (may start earlier if shock is expected)

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Supine to support BP
  • Keep warm, prevent heat loss
  • Oxygen to SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • (Bleeding control and splinting: for trauma)

PCP adds (en route or if delayed)

  • Vascular access
  • Bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, if hypoperfused
  • Reassess every 500 mL
  • TXA is listed: see the BC exam slide
slides.say: Now the bleeding GI patient. The BC hypovolemia protocol applies when there's evidence of blood or fluid loss, a systolic under ninety, and other signs of shock, and you may start earlier if you expect shock. In the all-levels column, the parts that fit a GI bleed are: lay the patient flat, keep them warm, and give oxygen to keep the saturation at ninety-four or higher. Bleeding control and splinting are for trauma. The PCP column is yours: en route, or on scene if there's a delay, start an IV and give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres if the patient is hypoperfused, reassessing every five hundred. The protocol also lists TXA; we'll look at that carefully later.
slides.sayZh: 现在看消化道出血的病人。BC 低血容量流程适用于有血液或体液丢失证据、收缩压低于九十、并有其他休克征象的病人；如果预计会休克，可以更早启动。所有级别那一栏里，适合消化道出血的是：平卧、保暖、给氧使血氧维持九十四以上。止血和固定是针对创伤的。PCP 那一栏是你的：在途中，或现场有延误时，开静脉；如果灌注不足，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升复评。流程里也列了 TXA，我们后面仔细讲。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Internal GI bleeding can't be stopped in the field: never delay transport
  • Too much saline dilutes clotting factors and can worsen bleeding
  • Listen to the lungs before and during fluids
  • SpO₂ 96% can still mean poor oxygen delivery if hemoglobin is low
  • Antiemetics: check long QT, pregnancy, glaucoma, age first
  • Blood thinners (warfarin, clopidogrel…) make bleeding harder to stop
slides.say: Here are the new watch-outs. First, you can't stop internal GI bleeding in the field, so your IV never delays transport. Second, fluid is a double-edged tool. The book warns that large amounts of saline dilute clotting factors and can make the bleeding worse, and too much can cause pulmonary edema. So listen to the lungs before you start and again as you go. Third, don't trust a normal-looking saturation: with low hemoglobin, ninety-six percent can still mean the tissues are short of oxygen, and BC treats shock with high-flow oxygen. Fourth, check the antiemetic cautions before you give one. And ask about blood thinners like warfarin or clopidogrel.
slides.sayZh: 新的注意事项：第一，消化道内出血在现场止不住，所以开静脉绝不能耽误转运。第二，补液是双刃剑：书里提醒大量生理盐水会稀释凝血因子、加重出血，过多还会导致肺水肿，所以补液前先听肺，过程中再听。第三，别相信看起来正常的血氧：血红蛋白低时，九十六也可能意味着组织缺氧，BC 对休克病人给高流量氧。第四，给止吐药前先查禁忌和注意事项。还要问有没有用抗凝药，比如华法林或氯吡格雷。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Book's pain drugs (morphine, fentanyl, meperidine, ketorolac): not BC EMR/PCP drugs
  • Book: ondansetron, diphenhydramine. BC N/V protocol: ondansetron, dimenhydrinate
  • Book bolus 10–20 mL/kg → BC 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess q 500 mL
  • TXA in GI bleeding: book says not routine; BC TXA indications are written for trauma
  • EMRs have no IV access in BC
slides.say: Now where the book and BC differ. For pain, the book lists morphine, fentanyl, meperidine and ketorolac. Opioid pain relievers are not in BC EMR or PCP scope, and ketorolac isn't one of the eighteen BC exam drugs. For nausea, the book names ondansetron and diphenhydramine, but the BC protocol names ondansetron and dimenhydrinate. The book's bolus is ten to twenty millilitres per kilogram; BC's is twenty per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. For TXA, the book says the evidence in GI bleeding isn't strong enough for routine use, and BC's TXA indications are written around major trauma and mechanism of injury. And EMRs have no IV access in BC.
slides.sayZh: 现在看书和 BC 的差别。止痛方面，书里列了吗啡、芬太尼、哌替啶和酮咯酸；阿片类止痛药不在 BC EMR 和 PCP 范围内，酮咯酸也不在 BC 十八种考试药物里。止吐方面，书里写的是昂丹司琼和苯海拉明，BC 流程写的是昂丹司琼和茶苯海明。书里的推注量是每公斤十到二十毫升；BC 是每公斤二十毫升、最多两升、每五百毫升复评。关于 TXA，书里说用于消化道出血的证据不足、不常规使用，而 BC 的 TXA 适应证是围绕严重创伤和受伤机制写的。另外，BC 的 EMR 没有静脉通路权限。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Read the blood and the vitals: coffee-ground or melena = upper GI; orthostatic 20-10-20
  2. N/V protocol: PCP adds IV, ondansetron 4 mg PO or dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg, fluids
  3. GI bleed: supine, warm, O₂; PCP IV en route, 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess q 500 mL

Next: Chapter 35, Renal and Urologic Emergencies
slides.say: Let's wrap up. One: read the blood and the vital signs. Coffee-ground vomit or black, tarry stool points to the upper GI tract, and orthostatic vitals, twenty, ten, twenty, tell you how much volume is gone. Two: under the BC Nausea–Vomiting protocol, the PCP adds an IV, ondansetron four milligrams by mouth or dimenhydrinate one milligram per kilogram up to fifty, and fluids for hypotension. Three: for a GI bleed, lay the patient flat, keep them warm and give oxygen; start the IV en route and give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. Next time: Chapter 35, renal and urologic emergencies. If anything was unclear, tap Ask.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，读懂血和生命体征：咖啡渣样呕吐物或黑色柏油样便指向上消化道；体位性生命体征二十、十、二十告诉你丢了多少容量。二，按 BC 恶心呕吐流程，PCP 多了静脉通路、口服昂丹司琼四毫克或茶苯海明每公斤一毫克最多五十毫克，以及低血压时补液。三，消化道出血：平卧、保暖、给氧；途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。下节课：第三十五章，肾脏与泌尿系统急症。有不懂的点「Ask」。
